this_proposal_scope: four Ti3SiC2 (0001) clean-surface fixed-geometry single points; two DEV points remain HOLD until an independent source family is identified

method_reference.note: The successful runner/lock are method references only; they do not bind the new surface inputs, authorize execution, or claim slab convergence.

kpoints.api_convention: GPAW kpts tuple; no explicit gamma flag and no additional shift

scf_convergence.eigensolver: GPAW default Davidson, matching the successful P0 MSR1 runner; no explicit alternative eigensolver

outputs: stress tensor in eV/Angstrom^3 and GPa, diagnostic only for slabs

loss_scope_proposal.TRAIN: forces only, after separate C role review; existing six-point approval does not automatically include these four new structures
loss_scope_proposal.DEV: model selection only, pending proof of independent parent family
loss_scope_proposal.slab_stress_warning: 3D stress is vacuum-volume normalized and must not be treated as bulk elastic data

execution_policy_proposal.checkpoint_policy: No persistent checkpoint planned after success; if interruption recovery is approved, use a temporary per-task checkpoint and remove it only after validated success. Exact checkpoint mechanism remains untested.
execution_policy_proposal.walltime_note: No platform-level job wall-clock cap was verified. The offline estimate is near a 4-hour budget at 41 SCF iterations; C must approve a safe limit or explicitly accept timeout risk.
